human_recognizability.finding: Native larger-human examples show clothed heads, torsos and limbs, including 14-person mixed scenes. Full sheets cover single/multi people at all factors. Far/nadir people are pixel-limited, and all eight appearances share one template.

lighting_realism.finding: Directional sun, subdued warm morning/evening and neutral noon produce coherent ground/object shading. No atmospheric or physically calibrated sky model is claimed.

scene_plausibility.finding: Targets are grounded and separated across single, crowd and mixed vehicle scenes. Layouts are simplified and do not model traffic/crowd behavior. Finite terrain and fixed far clipping expose background corners in 643/10000 frames, at most 7.045% of pixels.

shadow_realism.finding: Trees, vehicles, canopies and masonry walls cast localized shadows with both lit and shaded people. Shadows remain hard and some walls are deliberate occluders.

terrain_realism.finding: Photographic PBR grass, soil, asphalt and irregular mixed patches improve terrain fidelity. The terrain is planar and repeats mosaics; road layouts are simplified.

vehicle_recognizability.finding: Shaped cabins, wheels, cargo bodies and coach window/roof structure distinguish cars, trucks and buses. The retained assets remain stylized.

judgment: Acceptable improved simplified synthetic imagery under the revised smoke/pilot criteria. This is not photorealistic or equivalent to real aerial photography, and it supplies no real-world detector accuracy or sim-to-real evidence.
